g.text: Agent Runtime and CampusMate Attachment Boundary
Batch resolve is all-or-nothing and marks accepted rows referenced.
The first reference time is preserved and expiry is cleared.
No separate storage locator, OBS URL, or credential is returned.
Knowing an attachment ID does not authorize direct OBS access.
OBJECT_KEY_CONFLICT is quarantined from ordinary delete and cleanup;
only audited reconciliation may remove an object after ownership proof.
No content_version, reservation, or complex retention claim exists.
The permanent row retains exactly attachment_id, session_id,
status, created_at, and deleted_at after deletion.
MIME, expected and actual size, and sha256 validate content.
referenced_at and expires_at drive reference and 24-hour cleanup.
error, attempt, next-at, lease, and row-version fields recover workers.
After OBS deletion, one DB transaction removes this detail
and leaves the permanent row as a DELETED tombstone.
Runtime never reads OBS directly and never writes attachment files.
Local memory is a bounded stream buffer, not durable storage.
The database stores projected metadata only.
Attachment bodies remain authoritative in CampusMate.
read MIME, size, sha256, reference state
put, open, stat, or delete by attachment_id
same ID after routing or restart
persist id, name, MIME, size, sha256
